title: Make land --pr judge and guard the PR's current head
summary: Change `athena land --pr` so it judges checks of the pull request's current head and passes that head as the merge guard. It never force-replaces a newer head with the job's commit. It refuses, naming each extra commit and why, when the head is anything but the job's landing commit. Audience: the maintainer who landed PR #149 around land.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for each land behavior; cargo test and clippy clean.
Criteria check land's judging, guard and refusal by running tests.
Fix which commit land judges rather than working around it.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The land flow lives in crates/athena-core/src/land.rs with GitHub calls in gh.rs; I did not read them in depth.
Refusal compares the PR head sha to the job's landing commit and lists the commits between them.
The previous attempt's candidate touched gh.rs, main.rs, README.md and CHANGELOG.md, so those are likely again.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test (run with cargo test) shows that with a PR whose head differs from the job's commit and is green while the job's commit is red, land does not report the old commit's failure and judges the head's checks; and when the head equals the landing commit, land merges.
A test (cargo test) shows the merge request is guarded with the PR's current head sha, and that no push or update replaces a newer head with the job's older commit.

A test (cargo test) shows land refuses when the PR head is anything other than the job's landing commit, including when the extra commit is a declared intervention, and the message names each extra commit and why it is refused (squash with later commit invalid until D111 records-history build).
README.md or CHANGELOG.md document the new land behavior and the D111 interim refusal, so a maintainer can find why land refused.
cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check are clean; cargo test passes for the changed crates (the pre-existing reading_inputs_digest failure is noted if it persists).

out_of_scope: Fixing the pre-existing reading_inputs_digest test failure
Changing the squash-merge strategy beyond the guard
departures: Slightly higher cost: the earlier attempt was abandoned and the change spans land, gh and tests.
